title: Pearl Pop Cascade 珠光瀑语
description: A dreamy 3D pachinko-peg puzzle! Aim and fire steel orbs to shatter glowing dream-pearls across a starlit board. Chain hits in one shot to climb the score-multiplier ladder, purple pearls quintuple your shot, green pearls gift free balls. When only 10 pearls remain, FEVER grants three consecutive free orbs. Catch the roaming golden buckets for +1000 and another ball, clear the board for a 5000 bonus and a harder round. A soothing synth lullaby plays as pearls cascade.
controls: Move mouse (or touch-drag) to aim from the top launcher, click / tap / press Space to fire. Blue pearls score with a rising per-shot multiplier ladder, purple ×5, green +1 ball. Catch pearls in the moving golden buckets. P pauses, M mutes.
author: LightGame
